description: Create comprehensive seed data for regulations and action items, plus a README.md with setup instructions. The seed data should include realistic regulatory entries for GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, Apple App Store, Google Play Store, PCI DSS, HIPAA, ADA/WCAG, and SOC 2, each with multiple developer-friendly action items.
steps: Create prisma/seed.ts with realistic seed data including at least 12-15 regulation entries: GDPR Article 17 Right to Erasure update, GDPR Data Breach Notification requirements, CCPA/CPRA amendment on opt-out mechanisms, Apple App Store privacy nutrition labels requirement, Apple App Store in-app purchase policy change, Google Play Store data safety section requirements, Google Play Store target API level requirement, PCI DSS v4.0 migration deadline, PCI DSS new authentication requirements, HIPAA updated telehealth guidelines, HIPAA security rule amendment, ADA/WCAG 2.2 AA compliance deadline, SOC 2 Type II new trust service criteria, EU AI Act classification requirements. Each regulation should have: name, shortName, category (Privacy/AppStore/Security/Accessibility/Healthcare/AI), severity (CRITICAL/WARNING/INFO), region, affectedArea, summary (2-3 sentences plain English), fullDescription (detailed paragraph), whatChanged (specific changes), deadline (some with dates, some without), publishedAt dates spread across last 6 months

For each regulation, create 2-4 specific developer action items. Examples: For GDPR Right to Erasure - 'Add user data deletion endpoint at /api/user/delete', 'Implement cascade deletion for user-generated content', 'Add data export functionality (DSAR compliance)', 'Update privacy policy page with erasure request process'. For Apple App Store - 'Add privacy nutrition label to App Store Connect', 'Implement ATT (App Tracking Transparency) prompt', 'Remove third-party SDKs that don't comply with Apple privacy manifests'. Make each action item have: title, description (1-2 sentences explaining what and why), priority (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), techStackRelevance array (e.g., ['ios', 'app-store'] or ['web', 'aws', 'payments'])
Add seed script to package.json: 'prisma:seed' command using ts-node or tsx to run prisma/seed.ts. Add 'prisma' field in package.json with seed command configuration

Create README.md with: project title and description, tech stack list, prerequisites (Node.js 18+, PostgreSQL), setup instructions (clone, npm install, copy .env.example to .env, configure DATABASE_URL, npx prisma migrate dev, npx prisma db seed, npm run dev), environment variables documentation, project structure overview, available scripts documentation, deployment notes for Vercel (connect to Supabase/Neon, set env vars, prisma generate in build), license section
acceptance_criteria: prisma/seed.ts contains at least 12 regulation entries with realistic content
Each regulation has 2-4 associated action items with developer-focused descriptions
Action items have proper techStackRelevance arrays for filtering
.env.example has all required environment variables documented
TypeScript compilation passes with seed file included
verification: npx tsc --noEmit passes without type errors
